info.title: Statistics Canada Labour Force Survey vectors (WDS)
info.description: Keyless GET access to StatCan Web Data Service vector series. Used for CURRENT unemployment rates by census metropolitan area (table 14-10-0459: three-month moving average, seasonally adjusted, monthly) — the vector id per CMA/province is resolved once (getSeriesInfoFromCubePidCoord, coordinate '{geoMemberId}.5.1.1.0.0.0.0.0.0') and stored on the place.

get.summary: Monthly values of one WDS vector over a period range
get.description: Returns [{status, object:{vectorId, vectorDataPoint:[{refPer, value, releaseTime,…}]}}]. vectorIds is the BARE number (no 'v' prefix — the prefixed form is rejected with 'not valid. Error code = 3'). A future endReferencePeriod is accepted, so static producer args stay valid.

parameters.name: vectorIds
parameters.description: Bare numeric vector id, e.g. 1643279334 (Toronto CMA unemployment rate).

parameters.name: endReferencePeriod
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD; may be in the future.

200.description: Array with one entry per vector.
